name: worktrees
description: Remove the git worktrees and branches the worktrees CLI proves finished, after asking

interface.shortDescription: Remove finished worktrees and branches, with proof
interface.longDescription: Ask the worktrees CLI which linked worktrees and local branches are finished, show the ones it proved with the proof it found, and remove only those you choose, through the CLI. A squash merge leaves branches behind that git branch -d calls unmerged; the CLI proves them merged by ancestry, by content or by the forge's merged request, and prints the command that puts each one back.
capabilities: List the worktrees and branches proved finished, with the proof
Remove only the ones you choose, through the CLI
Print the command that restores each removed branch
defaultPrompt: Clean up the finished worktrees and branches here.
Which of my branches are already merged?
Prune the squash-merged branches in this repository.
